label: Quest available: Shelter for an Evangelist
text:
A new quest is available.

The quest is called 'Shelter for an Evangelist'.

If you don't accept the quest within 5 days, it will expire.

label: Bulk goods trader from Neveherda
text:
A caravan from (*Faction=Faction_0)Neveherda(/Faction) is approaching. They are a bulk goods trader.

They will hang around the colony for some time before leaving. You can attack them - but this will anger their faction!

label: Transport pod crash
text:
A prosthetic surgeon named (*Name)Paul(/Name) is crashing in a transport pod nearby. If he survives the impact, he will be badly wounded.

(*Name)Paul(/Name) is not affiliated with any faction. You can rescue him and hope he joins freely, or capture him for recruitment or slavery purposes.
<color=#D09B61FF>AJ</color> told a joke about computer games to <color=#D09B61FF>Loner</color>.

label: Sad wander: Zeke
text: <color=#D09B61FF>Zeke</color> has broken down and is wandering around in sadness.
